Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

Why this role exists

This domain runs on trade-offs, experience versus compliance, merchant versus developer, and those decisions are better made with evidence than with opinion. This role owns generative and evaluative research across the merchant lifecycle and the developer experience, and makes research a standing input to how the domain prioritizes rather than an occasional favor.

What you'll own

• The research roadmap across the domain's three clusters, prioritized against the decisions that most need evidence.
• Mixed methods: interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral/funnel analysis in partnership with Data.
• Turning findings into decisions PMs and designers act on, influence through evidence rather than authority.
• A lightweight insight repository, and a practical model for democratizing good-enough research while protecting rigor on high-stakes questions.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work across all three clusters, partnering with the PMs and designers who rely on your evidence to prioritize. You set the research cadence and the insight repository, and you decide where rigor matters most and where lightweight research is enough. Much of your impact comes through influence rather than mandate, moving decisions with evidence. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

• Mixed-methods UX research experience. You are fluent across qualitative and quantitative approaches.
• The ability to translate findings into product decisions and to influence without authority.
• Rigor paired with pragmatism on timelines, you know where depth matters and where speed is enough.

A strong plus: fintech/regulated or developer-audience research; quantitative fluency; ResearchOps or repository-building experience.

Role Purpose

Corporate Brand Operations & Performance provides hands-on operational and analytical support to ensure the seamless execution, governance, and tracking of corporate brand initiatives. Acting as the operational engine of the Corporate Brand Management team, this role is responsible for maintaining brand asset integrity, supporting end-to-end campaign tracking, compiling multi-channel brand performance data, and facilitating smooth cross-functional coordination

Scope of Work

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Brand Governance & Digital Asset Management

• Maintain, organize, and update the central Digital Asset Management (DAM) library.
• Perform routine brand compliance spot-checks across collateral, templates, and touchpoints.
• Log and follow up on brand guideline deviations with internal teams.

Campaign Operations & Timeline Tracking

• Track end-to-end campaign milestones against master project schedules.
• Monitor agency and cross-functional deliverable timelines, flagging potential delays early.
• Coordinate logistics for approvals, administrative sign-offs, and documentation.

In-Market & Regional Visibility Audits

• Collect and consolidate visibility reports and proof-of-execution photos from Regional Circles and channels.
• Identify visual merchandising and branding inconsistencies in regional rollouts.
• Maintain a structured visibility issue log.

Data Collation & Performance Reporting

• Gather brand and campaign performance data from media agencies, digital dashboards, and research partners.
• Maintain and update monthly brand KPI tracking sheets with high accuracy.
• Assist in drafting executive-ready presentation slides and monthly reporting packs.

Cross-Functional & Administrative Coordination

• Coordinate operational cadences, distribute meeting minutes, and track follow-up action items across Circles and agencies.
• Support procurement operations (e.g., PR/PO tracking, invoice verification, vendor liaison).

Requirements

Qualification:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related discipline.

Related Experience:
Typically 2–4 years in brand operations, marketing coordination, reporting or related roles; equivalent capability considered.

Skills

• Brand Stewardship: Solid foundational understanding of brand identity systems, design consistency, and guideline governance.
• Data & Tool Literacy: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, basic formulas) and PowerPoint/Google Slides.
• Experience with Project Management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, Jira) and DAM systems is an advantage.
• Project Coordination: Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple operational workstreams simultaneously.
• Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Meticulous Attention to Detail: High standard of accuracy in data reporting, proofreading brand assets, and tracking deliverables.
• Execution Discipline & Ownership: Proactive follow-through on action items without requiring constant supervision.
• Agility & Collaboration: Adaptable team player capable of engaging effectively with cross-functional partners and external vendors.
• Problem-Solving Mindset: Resourceful in identifying operational bottlenecks and proposing practical solutions to supervisors.
